verdict.rationale: Namecheap is a domain registrar and DNS SaaS product, so in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions are a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack describes such a feature. The pack covers only the XML API, RDAP records, the Terraform provider, the Go SDK, Dynamic DNS and community sentiment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
